description: This file defines a utility enum VoiceOverlayTextFormatting with static methods for formatting text overlays in a voice application, including computing text deltas and creating attributed strings with specific styles.

methods.name: delta
methods.description: Returns the substring of the current text after the committed prefix, or the current text if it does not start with the committed string.

methods.name: makeAttributed
methods.description: Creates an NSAttributedString combining the committed and volatile strings with different styles, used for displaying voice overlay text with visual distinctions.
